end_matter.text: Ziyuan Zhu designed the experiments, optimized the algorithms and wrote the manuscript. Jiayi Ren assisted with checking the experimental results and pushing updates to the GitHub repository. Shuyu Zhou researched journal submission policies and assisted with organizing the supplementary files. Mengting Zhu checked the manuscript grammar and verified the information entered in the final submission forms. Yin Shen provided the experimental data and guided manuscript preparation and submission. All authors reviewed and approved the manuscript and its submission to Applied Spectroscopy.
